description: Feedback about a project (and the page it was given on), saved by the person who gave it, in their own account. Read by feedbai (https://github.com/internet4000/feedbai) through backlink indexes; projects file it as GitHub issues.

project.description: The project the feedback is for, as its repository URL: https://github.com/owner/name

subject.description: The page the feedback is about: origin and path only (no query string or fragment, which can hold tokens or personal data)

kind.description: Optional: what kind of feedback it is

post.description: Optional: a Bluesky post made at the same time, where replies can go
